# F1 Stories: Data-Driven Narratives

<!-- badges: start -->
<!-- badges: end -->

This project is a deep dive into Formula 1 telemetry and results, with a specific focus on the 2026 Technical Revolution. While many look at the standings, "F1 Stories" looks at the "why."

Key Research Questions:

* The Hybrid Shift: How does the 50/50 ICE-to-Electric power split change driver throttle application?

* The Aero Game: Visualizing the impact of active aerodynamics on straight-line speed.

* The Teammate Duel: Who is winning the internal battle when the car is a "black box" of new regulations?
